Title: [LSJ] Herald of Topheth and Mask of Thousand Faces Question

Messages.Author: Maschenka
Messages.Body:
HI LSJ,

I got a little question for you.

Assuming I have a Herald and another Vampire with obf and pre.

My prey´s vampires have Memories of Mortality on them. I bleed with
Herald using a Legal Manipulation. Since none of my prey´s vamps can
block the action my prey must refuse to block. Then I play the Mask of
Thousand Faces with lets say Lena Rowe. Has my prey another chance to
declare blocking?

Does this unblockable effect carry over?

Andreas Nusser
andreas...@vekn.de
www.vekn.de

not allowed to block because of some reason. It does not give you a second
chance to declare blocking.

Messages.Author: henrik ericsson
Messages.Body:
"Johannes Walch" <joha...@scram.de> wrote in message news:<at1m9k$dub$1...@stu1id2.ip.tesion.net>...


But unless the player who wants to play Eagle's Sight has declined to
block, he could play it after the mask was played in the example
above. And if he/she doesn't have a bunch of memories on his/hers
vampires and he/she wanted to block the action, I don't see why
shhe/he would decline...

So if the combo with the mask should work as planned, the acting
methusaleh must ask every other methusaleh if she/he blocks and after
all of them has declined, he plays the mask...
Works even beter with Toreador Grand Ball or The Grandest Trick...

/Henrik
